title: Prins et al. (2021): Cadmium oleate stock from cadmium acetate dihydrate
scopeLabel: Source-scoped preparations and associated SAXS, microscopy and optical evidence from the complete 10-page main article and 32-page SI. CdSe, PbS and CdS routes, stocks, workup, separate laboratory benchmark, double-injection variants, single-injection controls and partial calibration preparations are distinct. Theoretical curves and reference structures are explicitly separated from measured specimens. No exact unreported batch, graph coordinate or atomic structure is reconstructed; no complete-paper Reader is claimed.

general_background.title: From a metal precursor to reactive species
general_background.summary: A metal precursor supplies the metal, while its ligands and conversion chemistry influence how reactive species become available. Stronger or more persistent coordination can slow release of reactive metal species, while ligand exchange can open alternative conversion pathways.
